test_case.description: Appium test for a deep Android Clock flow: launch Clock, create an alarm, label it, add a world clock city, configure a short timer, and open Stopwatch. Runtime device settings can still be overridden by Executor-Regenerator.

prerequisites.description: Android Clock is installed on the selected device. If the package differs, override app_package/app_activity in Executor-Regenerator's Appium device matrix.

steps.description: Verify that the Clock app is open.
steps.expected_outcome: Clock app shows one of its main tabs.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@text='Alarm' or @content-desc='Alarm' or @text='Clock' or @content-desc='Clock']")
assert element.is_displayed()

steps.expected_outcome: Alarm tab is selected.
The alarm time picker opens.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@content-desc='Add alarm' or @text='Add alarm' or contains(@resource-id, ':id/fab')]")
element.click()

steps.expected_outcome: Hour 7 is selected in the time picker.
Minute 30 is selected in the time picker.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@text='30' or @content-desc='30' or contains(@content-desc, '30 minutes')]")
element.click()

steps.expected_outcome: The new alarm is saved.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@text='OK' or @content-desc='OK' or @text='Done' or @content-desc='Done']")
element.click()

steps.description: Verify that the 7:30 alarm is displayed.
steps.expected_outcome: The alarm list contains the newly created 7:30 alarm.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[contains(@text, '7:30') or contains(@content-desc, '7:30')]")
assert element.is_displayed()

steps.expected_outcome: Alarm label input dialog opens.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@text='Label' or @content-desc='Label' or contains(@resource-id, ':id/edit_label')]")
element.click()

steps.description: Type Morning Demo as the alarm label.
steps.expected_outcome: Morning Demo is entered in the alarm label field.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@class='android.widget.EditText' or contains(@resource-id, ':id/label')]")
element.clear()
element.send_keys("Morning Demo")

steps.expected_outcome: The alarm label is saved.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@text='OK' or @content-desc='OK' or @text='Save' or @content-desc='Save']")
element.click()

steps.description: Return to the main alarm list.
steps.expected_outcome: The alarm list is visible again.
World clock screen is displayed.
The city search screen opens.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@content-desc='Add city' or @text='Add city' or contains(@resource-id, ':id/fab')]")
element.click()

steps.description: Type London in the city search field.
steps.expected_outcome: London is entered into the city search field.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@class='android.widget.EditText' or contains(@text, 'Search') or contains(@content-desc, 'Search')]")
element.send_keys("London")

steps.description: Press Enter to submit the city search.
steps.expected_outcome: London search results are shown.

steps.description: Select London from the city search results.
steps.expected_outcome: London is added to the world clock.

steps.description: Verify that London appears in the world clock list.
steps.expected_outcome: London is visible in the world clock list.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[contains(@text, 'London') or contains(@content-desc, 'London')]")
assert element.is_displayed()

steps.expected_outcome: Timer setup screen is displayed.

steps.description: Tap digit 1 in the timer keypad.
steps.expected_outcome: Digit 1 is entered into the timer setup.

steps.description: Tap digit 0 in the timer keypad.
steps.expected_outcome: First zero is entered into the timer setup.

steps.description: Tap digit 0 again in the timer keypad.
steps.expected_outcome: Second zero is entered and the timer shows one minute.
The timer starts counting down.
The timer is paused.
The timer returns to setup or idle state.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@text='Reset' or @content-desc='Reset' or @text='Delete' or @content-desc='Delete']")
element.click()

steps.expected_outcome: Stopwatch screen is displayed.
